name: save_skill
description: Render and save a skill into the configured skills directory. Simple skills are saved as a single .skill file; complex skills are saved as a directory package (SKILL.md + subskills/). Use proactively to persist reusable skills, including splitting a complex skill into multiple sub-skills. Saving a package for a name that already exists as a single `.skill` file deletes that old file.
first_use_guidance:
Guidance for distilling session experience into a reusable skill:
- Gather evidence first with search_overflow (past turns) and knowledge_search (saved facts); quote behavior, not project specifics.
- Generalize before saving: no absolute paths, hostnames, tokens, or single-project identifiers; state goal, inputs, steps, and done criteria.
- Iterate safely: save_skill with dry_run=true previews the rendered skill without writing; validate_skill checks the exact arguments; only then save without dry_run.
- Prefer validate_skill over re-saving to fix drafts, and delete_skill to remove a bad skill.

name.description: Skill identifier used in the YAML front matter (and default filename).

description.description: Short summary shown in skill lists and matching.

prompt.description: Full skill prompt body (Markdown). Saved after the YAML front matter.

system_prompt.description: Optional additional system prompt text to include in the YAML front matter.

tools.description: Explicit tool names that the skill is allowed to use.

tool_groups.description: Tool groups that the skill is allowed to use (e.g. builtin, executor).

mcp_servers.description: Required MCP server names needed to run this skill.

priority.description: Optional match priority; higher values take precedence.

file_name.description: Optional output filename for simple single-file mode (forces .skill suffix, sanitized). In package mode this field is IGNORED — directory name is derived from `name` via safe_skill_dir_name; do not rely on file_name to name the package directory.

overwrite.description: Whether to overwrite an existing file/directory at the target path (default: true; set false to fail instead of overwriting). Overwriting is permanent — the previous version is deleted, not kept as a backup.

dry_run.description: When true, validate and render the skill without writing anything; returns the preview plus warnings.

resources.description: Optional bundled resources to save alongside the skill. Each entry has `path` (relative, e.g. 'references/guide.md', 'examples/demo.md', 'scripts/tool.py') and `content`. When any resources or subskills are provided, the skill is saved as a directory package (SKILL.md + resource files).

path.description: Relative path inside the skill package, e.g. 'references/api.md' or 'scripts/helper.py'. Must not be absolute or contain '..'.

references.description: Convenience alias for resources under references/. Each entry has `path` (filename or relative) and `content`. Merged with `resources`.

examples.description: Convenience alias for resources under examples/. Same shape as `references`.

scripts.description: Convenience alias for resources under scripts/. Same shape as `references`.

subskills.description: Optional sub-skills to save nested under this skill's package (saved as subskills/<sub-name>/SKILL.md). Allows splitting a complex skill into focused sub-skills that can be activated independently. Each sub-skill requires `name` and `prompt`; may also include `description`, `system_prompt`, `tools`, `tool_groups`, `mcp_servers`, `priority`, and `resources`.
